description: This Java class 'RemoveUnneededTraces' is designed to analyze and optimize PCB layout files by removing unused segments and vias from a PCB data structure.

classes.name: RemoveUnneededTraces
classes.description: Main class for removing unused traces and vias from PCB layout files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes the optimization process with input and output file paths.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Performs iterative removal of unused segments and vias until no more can be removed.

methods.name: removeUnusedVias
methods.description: Removes vias that are not connected to any segment, considering special cases for ground net.

methods.name: findUnusedVias
methods.description: Finds vias that are not connected to any segment or have less than two connections unless ground.

methods.name: removeUnusedSegments
methods.description: Removes segments that are not connected to any module or via.

methods.name: findUnusedSegments
methods.description: Identifies segments that are unused based on connectivity.

methods.name: isUnused
methods.description: Determines if a segment is unused based on its connectivity to other segments or modules.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a point is connected to any element in a list of PCB nodes.
